title_sq: Okazion! Tek "Ekspozita Building" Shitet Apartament 2+1+2, Me Cmim 3000€m2 !
description_sq: Okazion! Tek "Ekspozita Building" Shitet Apartament 2+1+2, Me Cmim 3000€m2 !!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 5 te objektit 24 katesh. Ndertesa Multifunksionale "Ekspozita Building" ka nje pozicion strategjik buze Bulevardit Gjergj Fishta dhe karakterizohet nga cilesi e larte e ndertimit dhe arkitektura unike. title_en: Opportunity! Apartment 2+1+2 for sale at the "Exhibition Building", Price 3000€m2!
description_en: Opportunity! Apartment 2+1+2 for sale at "Exhibition Building", Price 3000€m2!!! The apartment is located on the 5th floor of a 24-story building. The Multifunctional Building "Exhibition Building" has a strategic position on the edge of Gjergj Fishta Boulevard and is characterized by high quality construction and unique architecture. Premium building for the city of Tirana is interspersed with commercial service units, office premises and apartments. The apartment has a total area of ​​176.33 m2 and is organized in the entrance corridor which distributes the premises, the living room together with the very spacious kitchen corner and with a spectacular view, completely with glass facades, a matrimonial room with its own toilet, a children's room and a day toilet.
